title: Café de la Mañana
ldInstructionsRaw: Add the tequila and Kahlua to a glass and top with fresh, hot coffee. Fold the whipped cream onto top of drink. Dust with freshly grated nutmeg.
Agave Nectar Whipped Cream: Mix 1 cup heavy cream, 2 Tbsp. agave nectar, and 1 tsp. vanilla extract together in a bowl until firm.
